world.name: Marrow Quay
world.core_conflict: Who forged the Salt Ledger, and who drowns when the spring flood comes

rules: Tide-craft draws on the moon's pull; it works only within sight of open water
Every working must be paid in salt, weighed and recorded
costs: Memory of a specific day, lost for good
access_restrictions: Only sworn tide-priests may keep a salt-scale

factions.name: The Tide-Priests of Marrow Quay
goals: Be seen to hold back the flood
factions.hypocrisy: They sell forgiveness while quietly forging the ledger that condemns
factions.language_style: Liturgical, everything in ounces and grains
factions.visual_markings: White-cracked hands, grey robes hemmed with salt

relationship_edges.summary: The clerks stamp what the priests weigh

factions.name: The Harbour Chain
resources: The harbour chain and its winch
factions.hypocrisy: They call themselves the city's protectors and flood the poor wards to move cargo
factions.language_style: Terse, everything timed to the tide
factions.visual_markings: A link of chain worn at the wrist

relationship_edges.summary: The clerks seized their cellars once

factions.name: The Customs House
factions.hypocrisy: They preach the sanctity of the record and sold its blank pages
factions.visual_markings: Ink-stained cuffs, brass seal on a cord

major_locations.name: The Customs House
major_locations.summary: A leaning brick hall where the Ledger is kept

major_locations.name: Marrow Quay
major_locations.summary: The working harbour, chain and tithe barges

major_locations.name: The Lower Wards
major_locations.summary: Half-drowned streets below the flood line

material_conditions: The spring flood comes in six tides
Paper rots; only sealed pages count
